plan.notes: Source: Blinn College District official Simulation and Game Programming AAS award plan page (blinn.edu/academics/degree-certificates/simulation-game-programming-aas.html; Approved 10/25/2022, Effective 1/1/2023), the current award plan referenced by the 2024-2025 Catalog Vol. 85. IMPORTANT TRANSCRIPTION RULE: rows whose course-name cell begins with 'or' are ALTERNATIVES to the preceding course row (programming-track vs art/media-track choice), not additional courses — this is the only reading under which every semester sums exactly to its declared total (14/14/16/16 = 60). Each such pair is transcribed as one choice slot with the first-listed (programming) course as the slot code. 'X3XX' rows are core-curriculum choice slots with the award plan's listed options. The award plan is a suggested sequence. No courses invented.
